title: Animators & Media Production Studios

rows.before: Help you claim software, equipment, and R&D tax credits.
rows.after: Help you claim software and equipment tax credits.

rows.before: <li>We prepare the SR&ED claim on Form T661 alongside your animation studio T2 return for qualifying experimental development work \u2014 the 35% refundable ITC on the first $3 million in eligible expenditures can recover a significant portion of your VFX or animation R&D costs each year.<\/li>\r\n
We prioritize catch-up T2 returns where the 18-month window has not yet closed to recover those credits.

rows.section: Services grid - CRA audit card bullet
rows.before: <li>We defend SR&ED claims during a CRA audit on your animation studio by presenting Form T661 project descriptions, time-tracking records for qualifying experimental development work, and documentation of technological uncertainty \u2014 CRA denies SR&ED when no contemporaneous records support the claim.<\/li>\r\n
Implemented project-based bookkeeping and claimed eligible software R&D credits.
